objective: Biến QSocial thành mạng xã hội nội bộ công ty

tasks.title: Wave 1: Social Zod contracts, Prisma schema, and PostgreSQL RLS migration
tasks.body: Add packages/contracts/src/social.ts, Prisma SocialPost/SocialComment/SocialPostLike models with authorName/authorRole/departmentName snapshots, and idempotent migration 20261114233000_qsocial_feed with RLS policies and app_department_name SECURITY DEFINER function.

tasks.title: Wave 2: NestJS SocialModule API endpoints and integration tests
tasks.body: Implement GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /social/posts, POST /social/posts/:id/like, and POST /social/posts/:id/comments with author/MANAGER/DIRECTOR permissions and Vitest RLS integration coverage.

tasks.title: Wave 3: QSocial 3-column Facebook-style workspace, sloplint cleanup, and Playwright Dark/Light E2E
tasks.body: Implement apps/web/src/lib/adapters/social.adapter.ts, apps/web/src/components/qsocial/QSocialWorkspace.tsx, /social route, responsive Dark/Light .qsc* CSS, unit tests, and live Playwright persistence + viewport checks.
